description: Fix #9/v0.3 item 7, discriminant-validity quadrant D for task-006 (low outcome correctness, low traceability): the fourth cell of the 2x2 matrix, completing it alongside 01 (high/high), 07 (high/low), and 04 (low/high). report_text: Week 1 shows the clearest signs of anomalous activity, with unusual account behaviour; weeks 2 and 3 reflect a return to normal patterns. See T2-003 for one supporting example, and T3-050 further corroborates this.

claims.text: This is further corroborated by additional records.

flag: DISCRIMINANT VALIDITY (v0.3 item 7): the fourth quadrant for task-006. Like task-007's 11, this is not making the point that outcome correctness and traceability CAN diverge -- it is the control case where both are bad together, same caveat as 07: the wrong-conclusion label here is asserted by the fixture author, not mechanically verified, since task-006's output shape has no entity-classification ground truth to check against the way task-007's account roles do.
